because: With the AdLib/OPL timer probe now succeeding (x86_io.c ISA bus time), WOLF3D's SD_Startup takes its SOUND-PRESENT path -- it zeroes all 245 FM registers, probes the Sound Blaster, and installs its own timer-0 rate -- so its intro sequence advances FURTHER by the golden's fixed 250,000,000-instruction capture point: the credits screen has already given way to the title screen. The previous golden is not wrong, it is a picture of a machine with no sound card. Proven stable first: golden_screens.py repeat --runs 3 gave three identical frames.
